title: Automatic reliability service contract and grouped inbox

request.source: User approval of sibling Jotto docs/AUTOMATIC_RELIABILITY_REPORTING_SPEC.md at 5897ee33; authoritative seven-criterion contract frozen by Jotto work_contract begin before implementation. This companion records website source, tests and delivery.

requirements.text: Strict safe automatic report contract, atomic grouped idempotency and terminal updates, rate/size limits, retention, legacy/manual compatibility, existing inbox visibility and verified Production rollout.

r06.implementation: Strict v1 allowlist, immutable receipts and transactional SQLite group/recovery updates, 300/minute admission ceiling, 32 KiB payload limit, 30-day scheduled detail erasure, private grouped inbox and updated privacy disclosure implemented.
r06.verification: Full local suite: 177 passed, 0 failed, 11 opt-in live suites skipped. Ten reliability tests exercise actual Worker routing and SQLite, including D1 trigger-inclusive change counts, inbox fairness, recovery ordering, duplicate delivery, transactional failure, schema parity and erasure.
r06.delivery: Production behavior at 1e23a04b611a358a3be71e8e99933254bcbec21f verified by the parent request probe: health capability, reviewed privacy HTML byte match, create 201, label 200, immutable retry 200, recovery 201, one grouped inbox occurrence, delete 204, absent 404, late retry 200 without resurrection (404). Three earlier failed synthetic probe groups were identified by synthetic-only build/metadata, deleted and verified absent.

review.requestMatch: Implements r06 service and privacy behavior; matching app sender remains independently under development.
review.correctness: Receipt insertion and grouped count mutation share one SQLite trigger transaction. Duplicate IDs never rerun counts. Explicit response statuses precede body parsing.
review.resilience: Terminal-before-initial recovery, lost acknowledgements, rate saturation and trigger failure rollback are covered. Delete and fixed transitions erase auxiliary incident details while preserving immutable digest receipts.
review.architecture: Extends the existing endpoint, D1 database, scheduler and inbox; adds no service or dashboard. Manual and legacy reports retain their established contracts.
review.testDepth: All 176 non-opt-in tests passed. New tests run production routing and SQL, not a mocked grouping algorithm. Eleven live tests were not run by the local suite.
review.risks: Website Production is verified; this does not establish app delivery. Eleven unrelated opt-in live suites were skipped. Digest-only receipts remain after incident detail erasure for immutable retries.
